line_segment_defaults.notes: The exact train page proves the passenger-stop order; official train and network guides prove the Joban Line corridor. This synthesis does not identify an N02 feature or historical-overlay section, so reference fields remain absent and confidence remains medium.

unnormalized_corridor_evidence.reason: The official source proves Joban service through Ueno, Tokyo and Shinagawa, but Ueno-Tokyo Line is a service name and does not prove the physical N02 line names or feature identifiers for Ueno-Tokyo and Tokyo-Shinagawa.

Official material proves the Nagoya-Nagano corridor via the Chuo Main and Shinonoi lines, but the reviewed pages do not state a train-specific transition boundary or physical N02 identifiers. No line or operator segment is normalized.
